opportunities.requirements: No follower minimum stated. You submit work or apply per listing. Content bounties are contests, only winning entries get paid, so pick briefs in your Privacy and AI niche where your edge is real.
opportunities.reward_text: Per listing, paid in crypto (usually USDC). Platform rate card quotes $500 to $1,500 for an X thread, $500 to $1,000 for a deep dive essay
opportunities.source: Superteam Earn / Solana Compass (checked Nov 2026: 243,000+ members, Nigeria chapter exists)
opportunities.summary: The Solana ecosystem work marketplace: bounties, freelance projects and grants for writers, designers and devs. Sponsors pay the full reward, platform takes no cut. For a creator page this is the most direct money board in Web3, threads and deep dives are literally your format.
opportunities.title: Superteam Earn, content bounties and gigs marketplace

opportunities.requirements: Join project communities on Zealy and complete their Creator Quests. No wallet needed to sign up, Discord, email or X login works.
opportunities.reward_text: Per quest, paid by communities in USDC managed by Zealy, or tokens, XP and roles. Amounts vary by project and sprint
opportunities.summary: Quest platform where communities post Creator Quests that pay contributors in USDC for creating content on X, plus clipping campaigns and leaderboard sprints. A steady drip of small paid content tasks rather than one big gig, good for filling quiet days.
opportunities.title: Zealy Creator Quests, get paid USDC for X content

opportunities.requirements: Open application on the Sentient Foundation site. Selection is monthly, based on the quality, consistency and impact of your contributions. Thought leadership content about open source AI is the core of it.
opportunities.reward_text: No fixed payment stated. Each month 10 Sparks are featured: X affiliate badge, direct line to the core team, incentives and access to future contributor and leadership programs
opportunities.summary: Sentient replaced its old ambassador framing with Sentient Sparks, a contributor pathway run by the Sentient Foundation. Applications are always open and Sparks rotate monthly based on contribution quality. It rewards visibility and access rather than a salary, so treat it as reputation building inside a project you already cover on the alpha board.
opportunities.title: Sentient Sparks, contributor program for open source AI

opportunities.requirements: Positions are referral only at this time: join the PIVX Discord, apply through the official form and state who referred you. You start as an Advocate; promotion to Ambassador takes 3 months and 3 nominations from existing Ambassadors.
opportunities.reward_text: Advocates are unpaid while they build a record. Promoted Ambassadors are paid a flat monthly fee in PIV, plus Ambassador of the Month PIV polls
opportunities.summary: PIVX is a privacy cryptocurrency, one of the few ambassador programs aimed at the privacy niche itself rather than general Web3. Low competition compared to the big L1 programs, and it deepens your privacy brand while it pays.
opportunities.title: PIVX Ambassador Program, privacy coin community

opportunities.requirements: Concrete gates: Discord Level 7, at least 3 on-chain transactions on Injective, and a submitted contribution portfolio. Applications through the official Injective Discord.
opportunities.reward_text: Monthly INJ token rewards starting at the Knight rank, five ranks from Ninja to Master
opportunities.summary: Injective relaunched its ambassador program on its official site: ranks from Warrior up, Ninja Missions with 5,000 INJ up for grabs monthly, and monthly INJ rewards for top contributors as you rank up. One of the few programs whose full mechanics are public on the project's own page.
opportunities.title: Injective Ninja Masters, rank based monthly INJ rewards
Binance Square Write to Earn, weekly USDC for content engagement and reader trades
opportunities.summary: Binance Square upgraded its Write to Earn program on Oct 19, 2026: KYC-verified creators are automatically eligible after their first post, with no registration or opt-in. You earn a 20% basic commission when readers trade through your content, plus a share of a weekly Engagement Bonus pool for genuine likes, comments and follows. Rewards are calculated weekly and paid in USDC to your Spot Account by the following Thursday. There is no fixed amount per post, the engagement bonus depends on quality and volume of engagement at Binance's discretion, and fake engagement can disqualify you.
opportunities.reward_text: 20% basic commission on reader trades plus a share of a weekly Engagement Bonus pool, paid in USDC weekly. No fixed amount per post
opportunities.requirements: KYC-verified Binance account. Publish text posts, articles or videos on Binance Square. No registration needed, eligibility starts after your first post.

opportunities.title: Swap.io x402 video bounty, $200 for a 60 second pitch on agent payments
opportunities.summary: Swap.io, a Solana swap platform whose Agent API lets AI agents get swap quotes and pay per call in USDC through x402, is paying for a 60 to 120 second video pitching one concrete way an agent could use x402 with Swap.io. Post the video on X tagging @swapdotio and @Superteam, plus a Medium copy. No code needed, mockups and storyboards are welcome, and a working demo with a Solscan link earns up to 30 percent bonus. Judging weights idea and clarity at 45 percent, production quality 35 percent and X reach 20 percent. Contest, only placed entries are paid. No deadline is stated on the listing, and submissions were still open when checked on Nov 11.
opportunities.reward_text: 1st $200, 2nd $125, 3rd $80, 4th $60, 5th $35; 6th to 10th get 40k XP for Season Zero. Contest, only placed entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: One 60 to 120 second original video, one entry per participant. Post on X tagging @swapdotio and @Superteam, and on Medium linking swap.io. AI voiceovers allowed, on-camera presence preferred. Optional bonus: show a real paid call to the Swap.io Agent API with the Solscan link.

opportunities.title: Gloam Video Contest, $600 for a 1 to 3 minute video on private money
opportunities.summary: Gloam, private money on public chains, is paying for a 1 to 3 minute video about what it does: an explainer, tutorial, skit or animation you made yourself. Post the video on X quoting the contest announcement and tagging @gloamtrade, then send the link through the form on the contest page. No AI-generated videos, one entry per X account, no fee. Judging weights clarity 40 percent, creativity 30 percent, production quality 20 percent, and a real flow in the app on mainnet 10 percent. Likes and views are not counted. Winners announced by 19 Nov on @gloamtrade, paid privately via a Gloam claim link in USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Base.
opportunities.reward_text: 1st $250, 2nd $150, 3rd $100, 4th $100. $600 total. Contest, only placed entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: One original 1 to 3 minute video, no AI footage, avatars or voices. Upload the video to the X post itself, quote the contest announcement, tag @gloamtrade, then submit the post link in the form on gloam.trade/contest. Showing a real private payment on mainnet scores higher.

opportunities.title: AirdropBuzz Creator Campaign, $625 USDC for Top 10 creators
opportunities.summary: AirdropBuzz, an airdrop discovery platform, is paying for original content about AirdropBuzz, airdrops, safety tools or Market Pulse: X posts and threads, Telegram posts, articles, YouTube videos or Reddit posts. Publish, then submit the link on the campaign page. Free to enter, up to 5 entries per creator, 68 creators joined and 75 entries approved so far. The deadline was extended from Nov 19 to Dec 26 because participation was lower than hoped. Rewards are competitive, not guaranteed. Off the Privacy x AI niche, but honest review content fits a creator page and the field is small.
opportunities.reward_text: 1st $175, 2nd $125, 3rd $85, 4th $65, 5th $50, 6th to 10th $25 each, plus 100 BUZZ points per ranked creator. $625 USDC total. Contest, only placed entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: Original content about AirdropBuzz or airdrops, in one of 5 formats (X, Telegram, article, YouTube, Reddit). Submit the published link on airdropbuzz.com/creator-campaign. Max 5 entries. No guaranteed earnings claims in the content.

opportunities.title: Bitget Wallet Virtual Account UGC campaign, $2,000 pool, 20 winners get $100 USDC each
opportunities.source: Bitget Wallet official blog, Oct 27 2026, checked 2026-11-13
opportunities.summary: Bitget Wallet is running a user-generated-content campaign for its new Virtual Account feature, USD and EUR account numbers inside the self-custodial wallet that convert incoming bank transfers into USDT or USDC, from Oct 30 to Nov 13, 2026. Open a USD or EUR virtual account for free, create original content about it, publish on X tagging @BitgetWallet with #BitgetWalletVA, then submit through the form linked in the official campaign post on X. One entry per person, 20 winners get $100 USDC each. The same wallet launched a stablecoin spending card in Nigeria on Nov 4, so the feature is live in the user's market, the official blog lists excluded regions and Nigeria is not among them, so the feature is available there.
opportunities.reward_text: $2,000 USDC total pool, 20 winners at $100 USDC each. Contest, only winning entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: Open a free USD or EUR virtual account in Bitget Wallet, create original content about it, post on X tagging @BitgetWallet with #BitgetWalletVA, submit via the form in the official campaign post. One entry per person. Nigeria is not on the blog's excluded-regions list, so the account is available there. Ends Nov 13, 2026, no end time stated, so enter today.

opportunities.title: KriptoK Creator Challenge, $200 USDC for content about perps and tokenized stocks
opportunities.summary: KriptoK, a trading platform for perpetuals, pre-IPO markets and tokenized stocks, is running a three-week creator challenge with $200 USDC in prizes. Publish one original post, thread, video or walkthrough about any KriptoK product, tag @KriptoK (or @KriptoKLeague for League coverage), join the Telegram community and submit the link on Superteam Earn. Judging weights audience engagement 40 percent, usefulness and clarity 30 percent, product accuracy 20 percent and originality 10 percent. No purchase, deposit or trade is required to enter, and the listing says you do not need a large following to win. Published Oct 28 as a three-week challenge, so entries close around Nov 18. Off the Privacy x AI niche and the top prize is small, but the format is one piece of content and ten creators get paid.
opportunities.reward_text: 1st $50, 2nd $35, 3rd $25, 4th to 5th $20 each, 6th to 10th $10 each. $200 USDC total. Contest, only placed entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: One original post, thread, video or product walkthrough about KriptoK. Follow @KriptoK and @KriptoKLeague on X, join the KriptoK Telegram community, tag @KriptoK in the content, submit the link on Superteam Earn before the deadline. No purchase, deposit or trade required. Create in English or add English subtitles.

opportunities.title: Oasis Sentinels, ambassador program for the privacy-first Oasis Network
opportunities.source: Oasis Protocol official ambassadors page, checked 2026-11-13; application form live
opportunities.summary: Oasis runs Sentinels, its ambassador network for the privacy-first Oasis Network: lead meetups, create content and represent Oasis globally, with exclusive bounties, professional mentorship and early ecosystem access. Rewards are bounty-based ROSE tokens for contributions including content creation, social media engagement and community outreach, tallied quarterly under the Ambassador Rewards program, and token delivery needs KYC through the Oasis Foundation. The application form on the official page is live and asks for an Oasis Sapphire address, so set up a Sapphire wallet before applying. A watched Privacy project on the board, and one of the few ambassador programs in the privacy niche itself.
opportunities.reward_text: Bounty-based ROSE token rewards for contributions, tallied quarterly. No fixed amount stated
opportunities.requirements: Apply through the official form on oasisprotocol.org/ambassadors: email, country, Discord and X handles, an Oasis Sapphire ERC-20 address, and short answers on your Web3 journey and why you want to join. KYC is required before any ROSE token delivery.
